section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the relationship between real-life creativity, particularly in artistic professional domains, and Executive Functions (EFs), based on the Model of Creativity and Attention (MOCA). It highlights that individuals in artistic professions demonstrate better overall EF and Shifting-specific abilities, and that higher artistic creative achievements are linked to improved Inhibition ability. The text presents a unified set of findings without explicitly delineating multiple studies.
